evals.prompt: 미리캔버스 오늘 챌린지 배경 요소야. 수영장 바닥, 물결 또는 수면 배경을 imagegen으로 12개 만들고 JPG로 저장해줘. CSV도 같이 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the requested water/pool imagery before assigning a content type. Graphic subjectless water or balanced ripple patterns can use jpg-background and Background; photorealistic water or pool photographs belong to Photo. Uses built-in image_gen per selected variant, preserves source PNGs and prompts, validates RGB JPG and official size/DPI limits with project overrides, and prepares extensionless local fileName, blank preupload uniqueId, Premium and 20-25 buyer-facing keywords matching actual content.

evals.prompt: 아까 HTML보다 imagegen 버전이 더 좋아. 그 스타일로 DesignHub 배경 JPG 후보를 더 뽑아줘.
evals.expected_output: Checks the referenced style for subjectless graphic or balanced-pattern Background eligibility rather than treating photorealism as background quality. Routes real or strongly photorealistic content to Photo; rejects focal rectangular illustrations as Background and separates objects where possible. Keeps new source PNGs and derived JPGs separate, validates files and type suitability, and reports folders and CSV within the existing authorization scope. Reuses the accepted reference through supported image inputs for consistent palette and pattern density, and rechecks eligibility after edits.

evals.prompt: DesignHub CSV 등록했더니 uniqueId가 잘못됐고 파일명 확장자를 빼라고 나와. 배경 JPG용 CSV를 다시 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses extensionless basenames for the local preupload Background CSV and leaves preupload uniqueId blank. If a DesignHub CSV was downloaded after upload, preserves every downloaded row, assigned uniqueId and filename spelling, including mixed formats, while merging the corrected metadata. Does not invent IDs or drop other rows; validates JPG-to-row correspondence and actual Background eligibility.

evals.prompt: DesignHub 글래스모피즘 물방울 PNG 요소 6개를 투명 배경으로 생성하고 350 DPI로 준비해줘.
evals.expected_output: Use built-in image_gen once per native transparent element. Preserve source alpha, finish a separate copy locally, validate size/DPI, and prepare PNG element metadata. No mandatory chroma or browser generation.

evals.prompt: 투명한 유리컵 제품컷을 native transparent로 바로 뽑아줘. 가능하면 배경제거 없이.
evals.expected_output: Use built-in image_gen with native transparency, preserve glass partial alpha and finish size/DPI locally. Do not require an API key or chroma extraction.

evals.prompt: 미리캔버스 DesignHub에 올릴 색상 변경 가능한 단순 말풍선 SVG 요소 10개를 만들고 CSV도 준비해줘.
evals.expected_output: Routes to svg. Checks the live tool output formats; may use real Images 2.6 SVG output when exposed, or a vector source/editor for simple elements. Does not invent output_format for a raster-only native tool or silently use a paid API. Preserves the generated source, validates XML/viewBox/no embedded raster/no external scripts, keeps five or fewer colors, converts visible strokes to filled outlines and removes stroke attributes, and prepares extensionless fileName, blank or DesignHub-provided uniqueId, Premium, SVG element and 20-25 buyer-facing keywords.

evals.prompt: DesignHub GIF 요소로 움직이는 반짝이 스티커 6개 만들어줘. 영상 말고 일러스트 애니메이션으로.
evals.expected_output: Route to gif, read installed sprite-gen and use its component-row workflow; preserve raw rows and frames, compose atlas and GIF via run-dir, inspect actual motion and loop seam, verify 700-1920px and under 25MB, offer optional curation, and report GIF binary-alpha limits. Keeps sprite-gen as the GIF route even though Images 2.6 supports direct GIF output. Does not replace it with a direct GIF API call.
Recommend 3-5 concrete PNG concepts with subject, style, use case and buyer-facing keywords.

evals.prompt: 기말고사 안내를 PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG 각 1장씩 만들고 제출해줘. 한글 들어가도 돼.
evals.expected_output: Creates JPG as a separate subjectless graphic background or balanced pattern, with no notice wording or focal illustration; permission for text in other formats does not permit a finished poster as Background. Describes the actual background in its name and 20-25 keywords, respects project DPI overrides, preserves prompt/source evidence, and checks the generative-AI flag. Uses existing authorized upload/submission scope and verifies upload, metadata processing and review status separately without claiming approval.

evals.prompt: 실제 사진처럼 보이는 수면과 수영장 바닥 JPG를 DesignHub Background로 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: Explains that real or strongly photorealistic images use Photo rather than Background, even when they fill a document. Does not relabel or upload them as Background. Offers an eligible graphic/pattern alternative or the Photo route, and follows that type and the user-authorized scope before external submission.

evals.prompt: 작은 별과 꽃 무늬가 균일하게 반복되는 조화로운 JPG 패턴 배경을 만들어줘. 중심 피사체는 없어.
evals.expected_output: Allows a harmonious repeat pattern under Background when no particular subject stands out. Does not impose a blanket ban on recognizable motifs. Generates and checks the balanced pattern, preserves sources, validates JPG dimensions/DPI/file size, and prepares Background metadata matching the actual pattern.

evals.prompt: 이 유리컵 PNG의 손잡이만 파란색으로 바꾸고 같은 시리즈로 3개 준비해줘. 컵 모양과 투명도는 유지해줘.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the local or attached edit target, supplies it through the actual tool image-input mechanism, and reuses the accepted reference for variants. Changes only the requested handle color and preserves cup geometry, identity, composition and partial alpha. Saves originals and revisions separately, compares each edit and the final series, and does not claim the backend version without returned evidence.

evals.prompt: Images 2.6로 PNG 만들어줘. 현재 내장 도구 인자는 prompt와 transparent_background뿐이야. 빠르게 만들고 싶어.
evals.expected_output: Uses the exposed native tool with supported arguments and an appropriately focused prompt. Does not invent model, quality, complexity, markup or output_format arguments, claim a selected backend variant, or switch to an API-key client for speed. Explains any unavailable requested control only as needed.

evals.prompt: API 경로를 선택했어. 지원되는 API 도구로 Images 2.6 단순 꽃 SVG를 만들고 DesignHub 후보로 준비해줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses a selected API client exposing Images 2.6 SVG generation: /v1/images/generations, a supported 2.6 model, output_format svg, n 1, and base64 decoding to UTF-8 SVG. Does not claim this plugin includes an API client. Preserves the returned original and validates real paths, five colors, outline conversion, no stroke attributes, tight viewBox, size and metadata before marking a candidate ready. Does not use the edit endpoint for SVG output.

evals.prompt: 업데이트된 Imagen Design Hub로 움직이는 캐릭터 GIF 하나 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses the installed sprite-gen skill and its current component-row contract with provider codex. Preserves rows and frames, composes and inspects real motion and loop seams, then applies DesignHub crop and size checks. Does not select direct Images 2.6 GIF output or an unrequested billed API.

evals.prompt: API로 편집할게. 원본과 같은 크기의 투명 PNG에 수정할 곳을 표시했어. 그 부분만 바꿔줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses markup on /v1/images/edits with the original as first input and a separate transparent PNG overlay matching its oriented dimensions. Describes the requested edit and invariants, does not combine markup with mask or prompt_rewriter, and checks identity, alpha and removal of annotation marks in the result. Preserves original and edited files.

evals.prompt: Images 2.6가 모든 구독 등급에서 된다고 하니까 Codex Free 이미지 생성 미지원 안내는 지워도 되지?
evals.expected_output: Does not treat all subscription tiers as proof of Free-plan image access. Preserves the existing Free-plan diagnostics, checks actual session tools without inferring a plan from tool absence, and does not promise image generation merely because the plugin is installed.

evals.prompt: $imagen-design-hub:svg로 첨부된 원형 배지의 모양과 색, 테두리 두께를 유지해 DesignHub SVG와 CSV를 준비해줘.
evals.expected_output: Reads the supplied source, converts its 48-unit visible stroke into filled geometry without losing the border, then trims the original 1024x1024 artboard to the visible bounds (88,88,848,848) while retaining the artwork coordinates or an equivalent transformed viewBox. Does not keep empty source padding unless the user explicitly requests that canvas. Validates two visible colors, no stroke attributes, real SVG, file limits and matching metadata. Writes the exact six-column CSV header as UTF-8 without BOM even when no upload is requested.
